## YT-Chatterino 2.5.7

- Vote in Twitch, YouTube, and Kick polls from the app using the browser extension.
- Choose an outcome and points for Twitch predictions in the app. Complete any Twitch-required terms or moderator confirmation in the browser.
- Use supported slash commands with Tab completion, and add or remove moderator and VIP roles where supported. Kick also includes OG role controls.
- Fix Kick OG badges and display Kick poll updates and the last observed results.
- Improve browser routing, duplicate-action protection, and reporting when an action cannot be confirmed.

Open the relevant channel in a browser with the updated extension installed. Kick role actions require the channel owner's connected account and an empty Kick chat input. Firefox requires the signed extension from this release.
